`src/engine/`: engine; `src/runtime/`: Python bridge; `src/levels/`: JSON/schema; `src/web/`: UI; `tests/`: tests; `.github/workflows/`: CI/quality.

Commands: `npm ci --ignore-scripts`; `npm run build`; `npm run dev`. Run focused tests first when possible, then full `npm test` before PR. Keep docs/tips runtime-accurate. Use small, focused commits; prefer Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`). Commit body: why needed; breaking change?

`npm run dev` 等でReactアプリを起動しての動作確認は**禁止**
`preview_*` ツール（`preview_start`, `preview_screenshot` 等）を**使用しない**
Stop hook の「Preview Required」警告が出ても `preview_start` を呼ばないこと
エージェントが確認できるのは `npx tsc --noEmit`（型チェック）と `npm test`（テスト）まで
Do not push directly to `main` (except initial repository setup).
Topic branch: `feature/<short-topic>`, `fix/<short-topic>`, or `docs/<short-topic>`.

Before PR: re-run `npm test`; run `npm run lint` (ESLint + sonarjs); review changed files/descriptions for accuracy. PR description: summary; validation (tests/commands); impact/migration notes (if any).
